description: N-channel MOSFET relay driver, logic-level, SOT-23
alternative_mpn: 2N7002 (lower current); ULN2003 (module driver)

source_evidence: AOS datasheet; boot waveform must be measured on a low-voltage fixture.

description: Single buffer/level shifter for 3.3 V to 5 V WS2812 data

source_evidence: TI datasheet; verify LED timing and supply decoupling.

source_evidence: Handsontec 2Ch relay datasheet; DigiKey TS0010D; verify exact batch/pinout/rating on arrival.
